title: 1984 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Rat
seo_title: 1984 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Rat (2 February – 19 February 1985)
description: 1984 is the Year of the Wood Rat (Yang, Jia-zi), from 2 February 1984 to 19 February 1985. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1984.
lead: Born in 1984? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Rat, but check the date: the 1984 Wood Rat year began on 2 February 1984. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1984: Year of the Wood Rat, from 2 February 1984 to 19 February 1985.

image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1984 was the Year of the Rat. It began with Lunar New Year on 2 February 1984 and ended on 19 February 1985, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1984 ends in 4, which makes it a Wood year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1984 is a Jia-zi year. The same Wood Rat combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1924 before it and 2044 after it.
Lunar New Year 1984 fell on 2 February 1984, so everyone born in January 1984, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Pig.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Rat guide describes the sign like this: “Quick-witted, resourceful, and sociable. Rats are natural problem-solvers who notice opportunities others miss.” The usual watch-out: “Can be restless or overly cautious with money and trust.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Rat page.
Careers often linked with the Rat: business, writing, research, trading.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1984
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Rat's best matches are the Dragon, Monkey and Ox, and its clash sign is the Horse, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Rat, it sits directly opposite the Horse, so 2026 is its clash year: a year to stay flexible and check plans twice.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Rat, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Rat years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1960 (Metal Rat); 1972 (Water Rat); 1996 (Fire Rat); 2008 (Earth Rat). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1984 is the Year of the Rat, a Yang Wood Rat year (Jia-zi).
When does the 1984 Year of the Rat start and end?
It starts on 2 February 1984 and ends on 19 February 1985.
I was born in January 1984. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Pig: Lunar New Year 1984 was on 2 February 1984, so all of January 1984 belongs to the Pig year.
Wood. 1984 ends in 4, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Rat compatible with?
Traditionally the Dragon, Monkey and Ox. The Rat's clash sign is the Horse.
